rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Drupal module that provides MCP server functionality for AI assistants working with Drupal sites. Built using the Tool API plugin system, it offers comprehensive site monitoring capabilities including security update checking, cron status analysis, watchdog log examination, content search, taxonomy browsing, user role inspection, and menu structure analysis. Features robust access control with permission-based tool categories, rate limiting for expensive operations, audit logging, and configurable read-only mode for production safety.
